enquiries.subtitle: Every admission enquiry and its follow-ups, from first call to admission.

applications.subtitle: Applications from the desk and online: review, documents, test, offer and admission.

confirm.REJECTED: Not offering a seat — say why

applications.admissionNoHint: Leave blank for the next number in the series
applications.admitHint: A student record is made from the application: the child, the parents (the applicant parent as the primary contact), the address and the previous school.
applications.noTest: Not put down for a test

tests.title: प्रवेश परीक्षाएं
tests.subtitle: Tests or interactions for applicants: who sits them, and their marks — which rank the merit list.
tests.deleteHint: Use this for a test scheduled by mistake. Once applicants are put down for it, it can’t be deleted — change its date or details instead.
tests.name: Test
tests.assignTitle: Put applicants down for this test?
tests.assignHint: Every applicant still in the running in these classes who has no test yet is put down, and their families are told the date, time and place.
tests.noApplicants: No applicants for this test yet

merit.title: मेरिट सूचियां
merit.subtitle: Applicants of each class ranked; publish the list, then offer the seats from the top.
merit.publishHint: The ranks are fixed on the applications, and families see their rank when they check online.
merit.allotHint: The next applicants in rank order are offered a seat and told by message, with the last day to accept; everyone below goes on the waiting list.
merit.allotted: {{offered}} seat(s) offered; {{waitlisted}} on the waiting list.
merit.missing_one: {{count}} applicant has no score yet — enter the test marks or the score first.
merit.missing_other: {{count}} applicants have no score yet — enter the test marks or scores first.

settings.title: Admission settings
settings.subtitle: Admission cycles: the classes open, their seats and age limits, how each is ranked, and the online application.
settings.name: Cycle
settings.yearHint: The academic year the children join (its sections are used to admit them)
settings.extraFormHint: A published form of type “Admission form section” (Administration › Forms)
settings.instructionsHint: Shown at the top of the online application: documents to keep ready, fee, contact.
settings.closeConfirm: Close {{name}}? No new applications will be taken.
settings.emptyHint: Set one up for each admission season.
settings.publicHint: Put this link on your website and social pages. Switch online applications and website enquiries on in Settings › Admissions.
settings.flowHint: The flow: enquiries are followed up → families apply (desk or online) → applicants sit the test → the merit list is published → seats are offered from the top → an accepted offer is admitted as a student.
settings.posterHint: Put it on banners, flyers and the gate: parents scan it and land on the enquiry form — each enquiry comes into Admissions › Enquiries.
settings.posterText: Point your phone camera at the code, fill in a short form, and our admissions team will call you back.
